description: Bacterial spot is a serious bacterial disease affecting tomatoes and peppers. It causes dark water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, leading to defoliation and reduced yield. The disease spreads easily in warm and wet conditions.
symptoms: Small brown water-soaked spots on leaves
Spots merging to form large dark streaks
disease_cycle: Bacteria survive in infected seeds and crop debris
Bacteria spread by rain splash or contact
They enter plants through stomata or wounds
Lesions form on leaves and fruit
Bacteria multiply and spread to nearby plants
impact: Fruit quality loss due to lesions
Possible crop failure in severe outbreaks
cultural_control: Avoid working in fields when plants are wet
biological_control: Use beneficial microbes such as Bacillus-based bio-pesticides
Apply biological plant protection products where available
prevention: Monitor crops regularly during warm wet weather
